With the Fifth International Polar Year (2032–33) on the horizon, a discussion at
Christchurch's Antarctic Season Opening on 21 September 2026 focused on investing in the next
generation of Antarctic expertise. Rodrigo Gomez-Fell facilitated it, and also presented a
[poster](../publications.qmd#ref-gomezfell2026seasonopening) at the event. The event is
listed on the [Teaching](../teaching.qmd#season-opening-2026) page.
